name: Butler's Bouquet
source:
After the devastating loss of her grandma, Nila has been in low spirits. In an effort to cheer her up, her best Friends Hadassa and Liyana take Nila to a fancy cafe called Butler's Bouquet. During their visit there, they find the anticipated rose gardens less impressive than expected, and with the encouragement of her friends, Nila offers her horticulturist skills to get the cafe gardens back into tip-top shape. Guide Nila in her encounters with each of the handsome butlers while she rediscovered the joys in her life.

Themes: romance, new beginnings, gardening, grief

Source: official X account (https://x.com/hanabiem/status/1657971589902737409?t=OoRvCtYnAQcMy6vojq9PGw&s=19)
translation:
失去祖母后，妮拉一直情绪低落。为了让尼拉振作起来，她最好的朋友哈达萨和莉亚娜带尼拉去了一家名为巴特勒花束的高档咖啡馆。在参观期间，他们发现预期的玫瑰花园没有想象中那么令人印象深刻，在朋友的鼓励下，妮拉发挥了她的园艺技能，使咖啡馆花园恢复了最佳状态。引导尼拉与每一位英俊的管家相遇，同时让她重新发现生活中的乐趣。

主题：浪漫、新的开始、园艺、悲伤

来源：X官方账号（https://x.com/hanabiem/status/1657971589902737409?t=OoRvCtYnAQcMy6vojq9PGw&s=19）
